errors.text_span: and labeled with its name, percentage, and absolute count
errors.evidence: The slice labels on the chart show the category name and percentage (e.g., 'chat (41.2%)'), but not the absolute count. The absolute counts are provided in the legend.

errors.text_span: with the slices arranged in descending order of size from left to right
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in descending order. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the slices are arranged in ascending order of size (6.9%, 9.0%, 9.3%, 11.6%, 21.9%, 41.2%). Also, 'from left to right' is not an appropriate way to describe the arrangement of slices in a pie chart.
